prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
competitors_mentioned: Dallas Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective “best” lawyer for every truck-accident case. The right choice depends on the injuries, evidence, and whether the case may need to go to trial. **A reasonable starting point is to interview two or three attorneys who regularly handle commercial-truck cases**, rather than choosing based on ads or a single ranking.

Super Lawyers’ Dallas trucking-accident directory lists attorneys including **Geoffrey Schorr, Andrew L. Payne, Shane V. Mullen, and Frank L. Branson**. That’s a shortlist to investigate—not a guarantee that any one is best for your case. [See the directory](https://attorneys.superlawyers.com/trucking-accidents/texas/dallas/).

When you speak with firms, ask:
- How many truck-crash cases like yours have **you personally handled**?
- Who will handle the case day to day, and have they taken similar cases to trial?
- How will the firm preserve evidence such as truck data, driver logs, and maintenance records?
- What are the contingency fee and case-cost terms, in writing?

You can also use the **Dallas Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service** for a local referral and a 30-minute consultation for $20: [214-220-7400](https://www.dallasbar.org/lawyerreferralservice). This is general information, not a legal recommendation.
